system.senses: Sees the front of the store and the shelf tops; hears, and repeats, its whole floor.
system.passive: Repeats what it hears, loudly and at length.
system.escalation: Alert 3, mutters. Alert 5, repeats every noise. Alert 7, shrieks at the first spider it sees: +2, once.
system.weakness: A cloth over the cage (quiet all night), a cracker (Persuasion, Difficulty 1).
system.biography:
“It Will Describe You. In Detail. At Volume.”

An alert parrot near the front of the pet store that repeats what it hears, loudly and at length. It has seen you. It will describe you. In detail. At volume.
